title: PubMed (research)
description: Biomedical literature from PubMed as a research source, through gohort's built-in PubMed search: it finds the most relevant articles, then reads their titles, journals and dates.
setup_notes: Get a free API key at ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/account (it raises PubMed's rate limit); it is sent as api_key. Run Test on its row under Admin > Extensions > Connectors, which makes one real search for a common phrase. Then add it under Admin > Extensions > Research Sources, which puts it to use: research asks it on the topics set there (suggested: medical, scientific), and a tool name there offers it to agents through query_source. Or pick it under Admin > Capabilities > Web Search as the engine. Its key is given where it is used, under the choice, or under Settings on its row in Admin > Extensions > Connectors.

questions.help: Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores; research and Web Search list it by this name.
